terminalFacts.fallbackStateInterpretation: Full valid BSD identity with a live state, not measured task resources. The original failed task queries carry no birth identity.

diagnosis.classification: Monitoring inconclusive during a changing same-owner build process graph; not the earlier same-child privileged-ps EPERM case.
diagnosis.established: Three distinct PID/birth snapshots each failed the task query with ESRCH while a later BSD query succeeded. Resource totals were correctly withheld and cleanup verified.
notEstablished: Exact lifecycle transition behind any initial ESRCH
That any initial failed query and its later BSD result referred to the same generation
A compiler error as the primary build failure
A signal as the primary compiler failure
Successful full-host/XUL completion or native authentication
diagnosis.kernelEvidence: The task-all flavor performs a live proc lookup and does not request zombies; the BSD flavor with nonzero arg can also find zombies. These are separate observations. proc_find has exec/shadow-process handling. This supports a race hypothesis but does not identify the observed transition. BSD state or flags alone cannot establish missing task resource totals.

minimumRecheckDesign.trigger: Only initial task size=0 and errno=ESRCH followed by a complete valid live BSD identity satisfying the external expected generation, same UID, and target group requirements.
minimumRecheckDesign.anchor: Bind the additional query to the first valid BSD (PID,startSec,startUsec). Keep this internal anchor separate from an external OwnedNative expected identity.
minimumRecheckDesign.budget: At most one immediate additional task read, plus the normal authoritative BSD fallback if needed; no recursion, sleep or widening of the outer three attempts and 0.25-second spacing.
minimumRecheckDesign.measurement: Accept only a complete task-all result with the same anchor and every existing state/owner/group/counter validation. Append that measured birth to the existing deduplication set.
minimumRecheckDesign.gone: Accept only an authoritative full valid zombie result, independently confirmed ESRCH, or replacement of an externally expected owned generation. Flags such as INEXIT are not absence.
minimumRecheckDesign.replacementHazard: When the external expected identity is absent, an internal-anchor mismatch with a new live same-PID/same-PGID generation must remain unknown. Calling that slot gone could discard a current group member and fabricate a complete resource total.
minimumRecheckDesign.persistentOrInvalid: Live persistent ESRCH, permissions, short/invalid identity, invalid task counters, owner changes or unresolved membership remain unavailable/null. Permission errors do not trigger additional attempts.
minimumRecheckDesign.evidence: Retain bounded original/fallback/recheck outcomes and anonymous generation tags. Preserve recovery diagnostics without unbounded arrays or replacing first failure.
minimumRecheckDesign.qualification: This is a safe candidate for a transient window; it is not proven to resolve the observed run or every process-churn race.

failureMessageEvidence.availability: The private full-build log is not present in collected job output or retained artifacts. The original error text cannot be reconstructed from the marker count.
failureMessageEvidence.currentImplementation: The error-colon count is generated from a bounded private tail after Runner cleanup. It may include output caused by monitor-triggered termination; exitCode=1 does not disambiguate the chronology.
failureMessageEvidence.minimumCollection: Capture a bounded classified tail before cleanup signals and distinguish it from any after-cleanup capture. Keep a hard byte, line and record cap, and catch collector failures without changing primary firstFailure.
publicAllowlist: Validated repository-relative source file and bounded line/column
excluded: Arbitrary free-text messages or quoted strings
Full argv, environment, absolute filesystem paths or URLs
Secret/token patterns and private non-diagnostic text
failureMessageEvidence.unknown: Use unclassified or unavailable without raw fallback text. Canonical allowlisted categories must not be described as verbatim original excerpts.

requiredTargetedTests: Initial ESRCH plus valid live anchor followed by full same-birth counters recovers once.
Same-birth zombie and independent ESRCH reconcile to gone; no flags-only reconciliation.
Initial or recheck permission, persistent live ESRCH, malformed/short BSD, and invalid task counters remain unknown.
Same PID/different live birth in the same target PGID stays unknown in group sampling, including null totals and no confirmed-gone increment.
An externally expected replaced owned generation preserves the existing gone behavior without changing group membership selection.
Retry count is bounded with no recursive rechecks; outer attempts and spacing remain unchanged.
Failure diagnostics separate before/after cleanup, apply all byte/record caps, suppress arbitrary secret-like text and retain primary failure when collection fails.
An SDK-free actual-Mac own-child/churn gate would be needed before claiming execution qualification; no additional full build is needed for implementation review.
invariants: No resource-role exclusions or privilege changes
Original failure and unavailable native authentication retained

reviewerActions.method: Read-only decoded evidence and committed source review, terminal provider API check, and official Apple source comparison.
